description: Parking Citations is a dataset listed in City of Norfolk open data portal (data.norfolk.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Norfolk. This dataset provides information about parking citations issued in Norfolk. The dataset includes the date and time the citation was issued, the violation description and status, where the citation was issued, the license plate number of the vehicle, the make and style of the vehicle, and the amount of the parking citation fine. Coverage: Norfolk, Virginia. The portal files it under the category Government. Its tags are city services & operations, code, date, model, status. The table has 9 columns. Attribution on the portal: Division of Parking. The portal shows 2024-04-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-norfolk-gov-portal.
